critical_code_review_comments: SITEMINDER: _resolve_channel falls back to 'booking_com' for unknown codes — silently misroutes reservations from unknown OTAs. Consider returning None + rejecting the webhook or logging a warning instead of defaulting to BDC.

DIRECT-CONVERSION: /redeem is public (by design for booking widget) but has no rate limiting or CAPTCHA — potential brute-force enumeration of DIRECT-XXXXXX coupon codes (36^6 = ~2.1B, still feasible with parallel scans). Consider a per-IP rate limit or lockout after N invalid attempts.

DIRECT-CONVERSION scan endpoint iterates all offered_ids by streaming db.direct_conversion_offers.find() into a set — with 100k+ offers this becomes memory-heavy; use existence check `find_one({booking_id, ..})` inside loop or aggregate approach.
SITEMINDER _parse_ota_xml uses ET.fromstring on external body — vulnerable to XXE / XML bomb. Use defusedxml.ElementTree instead.
DIRECT-CONVERSION _send_offer_email awaits nothing for resend.emails.send (synchronous library) — blocks event loop on real send. Wrap in asyncio.to_thread when a real key is used.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 test booking via SiteMinder webhook (rid=HOOK-*) and its direct-conversion offer (mocked email). ~105 direct_conversion_offers now in DB. Also inserted 1 override mapping HRS→expedia via PUT /api/siteminder/mappings.

rca of the issue: Main agent implemented backend + React components + render switch + RBAC map for both features but forgot to register the two new items in the sidebar `menuSections` System group (App.js ~2942-2992).
